metadata.question: Was there more sea ice visible in Hudson Bay (56.271030, -87.160422) on July 29, 2020 than on July 13, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-1 SAR (C-band) for sea ice detection as it works through clouds - Location: Hudson Bay at coordinates (56.271030, -87.160422) - Two dates: July 13, 2020 and July 29, 2020 - Need to compare ice extent/coverage between these dates 2. Masking strategy: - SAR data doesn't need cloud masking - For sea ice, we can use VH or VV polarization - typically lower backscatter values indicate ice - Define a threshold to classify ice vs water (ice has lower backscatter than open water) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Legitimately no ice detected (answer B if July 29 has less/equal ice) - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare ice pixel counts or ice area between the two dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-87.160422, 56.271030]); const roi = point.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer for regional analysis const date1 = '2020-07-13'; const date2 = '2020-07-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Using Sentinel-1 SAR for sea ice detection const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VH')) .select('VH'); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VH')) .select('VH'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 13 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`July 29 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mosaics and detect ice const img1 = col1.mosaic(); const img2 = col2.mosaic(); // Ice detection: VH backscatter < -20 dB typically indicates ice const iceThreshold = -20; const ice1 = img1.lt(iceThreshold); const ice2 = img2.lt(iceThreshold); // 4. Calculate ice area (count ice pixels) const stats1 = ice1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = ice2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count1 = ice1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const icePixels1 = stats1.get('VH').getInfo(); const icePixels2 = stats2.get('VH').getInfo(); const totalPixels = count1.get('VH').getInfo(); console.log(`Total pixels analyzed: ${totalPixels}`); if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (icePixels1 === null || icePixels2 === null || isNaN(icePixels1) || isNaN(icePixels2)) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`July 13 ice pixels: ${icePixels1}`); console.log(`July 29 ice pixels: ${icePixels2}`); console.log(`Ice coverage July 13: ${(icePixels1/totalPixels*100).toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`Ice coverage July 29: ${(icePixels2/totalPixels*100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (icePixels2 > icePixels1) { console.log('More ice on July 29 than July 13'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Equal or less ice on July 29 than July 13'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
